decision: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST — All four frozen decision conditions pass at the bounded localhost stochastic-mock ceiling. C1 auth discrimination 0.8333 > 0.5 (positive control, replicating EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583). C2 behavioral TP 1.0 >= 0.85 on all three drift types in isolation and 8/8 co-occurring conditions. C3 behavioral variance 8/8 conditions with std > 0.05 (range 0.087–0.104) AND orthogonality confirmed at delta=0.15 (pooled r=-0.0258, 95% CI [-0.115, 0.064], CI upper 0.064 < 0.15, TOST p_upper 5.6e-05 < 0.05, shared variance < 0.4%). C4 noise FP 0.0 <= 0.15 on 240 noise-only samples. Audit PASS confirms all recomputed metrics match producer exactly. The three root causes of parent EXP-PRODUCT-35434772331 measurement invalidity — deterministic server, scoring weight collisions, server state carry-over — are resolved. However, the claim ceiling is strictly bounded to localhost stochastic mock (Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite WAL + TTL cache 0.5s + jitter 10-100ms + HS256/RS256 JWT on 127.0.0.1:18950, seed 42). No production generalization, PRODUCT_CORE promotion, or non-mock inference is warranted from this evidence alone.

The parent MEASUREMENT_INVALID (EXP-PRODUCT-35434772331) is resolved: behavioral variance restored (8/8 conditions std 0.087–0.104), orthogonality confirmed at delta=0.15 (pooled r=-0.0258, CI upper 0.064, TOST p_upper 5.6e-05) on stochastic Flask+SQLite mock matching EXP-GRAPH-35353011131. This is the second independent confirmation of orthogonality at delta=0.15 after EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 (r=0.046, CI upper 0.135). Structural signal discrimination validated (0.8333). Behavioral drift detection validated (TP=1.0, all three types). Noise tolerance validated (FP=0.0). However, claim ceiling bounded to localhost mock: does NOT generalize to production OAuth/OIDC/CDN endpoints, real network RTT, non-mock substrates, broader noise/drift coverage, or continuous severity distributions. Token_refresh excluded from orthogonality set (deterministic std=0.0 by design). Six structural signal families remain falsified for C-FRESHNESS frozen gate (Jaccard, TF-IDF, response-time KS, linear ensemble, field-usage, schema comparison). Behavioral signals remain the validated detection dimension. No product promotion warranted.

product_action: No code changes to production. C-FRESHNESS orthogonality confirmed at mock ceiling; parallel-channel architecture (behavioral + structural as independent channels) is justified ONLY at this ceiling. Freshness guards are the next product gate but require production-substrate validation before integration. C-PRODUCT-ECON remains REJECTED (closed in prior chain). No Product Core promotion authorized.

reason: This experiment successfully resolves the single blocker (C3 measurement invalidity) that prevented C-FRESHNESS from advancing. All four frozen decision conditions pass with audit PASS confirmation. The three root-cause fixes are verified on wire: stochastic server produces real behavioral variance, redesigned scoring produces non-overlapping drift-type ranges, and server state reset prevents cross-condition contamination. However, PRODUCT_CORE promotion is explicitly blocked by the localhost mock ceiling: (1) the audit validity finding V_LOCALHOST_REPRESENTATION_LOSS rates severity as high — zero LLM calls, localhost-only, no production middleware; (2) six of nine do_not_assume items from the parent handoff remain active (production generalization, co-occurring token_refresh, non-mock substrate); (3) the audit claim_ceiling states 'Does NOT support: production OAuth/OIDC/CDN endpoints, browser/network RTT, non-mock substrates, broader noise/drift coverage, or PRODUCT_CORE promotion.' The accumulated evidence chain across EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 (graph lane, r=0.046), EXP-GRAPH-35389145821 (graph lane, r=0.0022 with HTTP caching), and this product-lane replication (r=-0.0258) consistently shows near-zero pooled correlation at delta=0.15, but all three are localhost mock measurements. The next high-information question requires bridging the mock-to-production gap, which is a runtime-lane concern requiring a production-like substrate test. Product lane has no further frozen design to execute for C-FRESHNESS at this ceiling.
